description: This file defines models and a fetcher for Seeking Alpha calendar earnings data, including query parameters, data validation, data transformation, and asynchronous data fetching from the Seeking Alpha API.

classes.name: SACalendarEarningsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Seeking Alpha earnings calendar, including country selection.

classes.name: SACalendarEarningsData
classes.description: Represents individual earnings calendar data with additional fields like market cap, reporting time, exchange, and sector ID.

classes.name: SACalendarEarningsFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous fetcher class that retrieves and processes Seeking Alpha earnings calendar data based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters by setting default start and end dates if not provided.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches earnings data from Seeking Alpha API for specified date range and handles response validation.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw API data into standardized SACalendarEarningsData objects, sorted by release date.

methods.name: validate_release_date
methods.description: Validates and parses the release date string into a date object.
